geometry.derivationNote: The signed archival original and official PSZRI printing source-verify the legal inclusion of the Crimean Peninsula, Taman and the Kuban side. Exact territory-area geometry must reconstruct the 1783 Crimean/Kuban political scope and coastline from contemporary official cartography; modern Crimea/Krasnodar administrative polygons are not substitutes.

The official bilingual treaty printing source-verifies recognition of Russian supreme authority and protection while preserving Kartli-Kakheti as a separate kingdom. Visualization therefore requires a period Kartli-Kakheti polygon on a protection/claim layer, never a 1783 Russian sovereign-territory fill.

routeSemantics.note: The later Treaty of Jassy explicitly confirms the 28 December 1783 act as concerning Crimea/Taman accession and the Kuban as the boundary in that sector.

geometry.derivationNote: The official federal archival chronology states that the act marked Ottoman recognition of Crimea's accession to Russia and established new borders. This is a recognition/status layer over the 1783 Russian acquisition rather than a second acquisition. Exact river/coastal geometry remains a separate period-geometry task.
